jackittome.configuration.title: JackItToMe Settings
jackittome.configuration.emi.tooltip: Options for the jack button shown on EMI recipes.
jackittome.configuration.forceRecipeButt: On (recommended): the jack button gets its own column beside each recipe, always visible and never overlapping recipe content. Off: we fall back to EMI's decorator system, which hides all mod-added widgets unless EMI's own 'Show Recipe Decorators' (Dev section) is enabled — with both off, no button appears at all. Only turn this off if a future EMI release breaks our placement.
jackittome.configuration.showRecipeButto: Show the jack button on recipes at all. Turn it off to pull only with the keybinds — the G keys, autocrafting and the hover tooltip keep working. The button already hides itself when there is nothing to pull from, i.e. when a recipe is opened with only your own inventory behind it.
jackittome.configuration.buttonOffsetX.t: Moves the recipe button horizontally, in GUI pixels. Positive moves it right.
jackittome.configuration.buttonOffsetY.t: Moves the recipe button vertically, in GUI pixels. Positive moves it down.
jackittome.configuration.placementKeys.t: While enabled, open any recipe and press Ctrl + the arrow keys to move the jack button; Ctrl+Home puts it back. The position is saved automatically, so you can switch this off again once it looks right.
